answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant mechanism via zero-knowledge verifiable delay to enforce dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, requiring each raven to lock staking collateral. This capital barrier proves that an adversary permitted to wander across topologies faces cascading slashing penalties, yielding strictly negative expected utility from identity multiplication, breaking like a willow. Thus, this subgame-perfect punishment matrix enforces robust Nash equilibrium convergence, ensuring unilateral Sybil deviations are strictly dominated, securing consensus.
